thumbnailPrompt: A breathtaking view of the sun's corona erupting in a massive solar flare, silhouetting the Earth in the distance. Use cinematic lighting with strong contrast between light and shadow. Photorealistic rendering style, evokes a sense of awe and impending power.
infographicPrompts: Diagram showing the Earth and the Sun with a beam of light traveling between them. Label the distance (93 million miles) and the time it takes for light to travel (8 minutes). Clean, modern design with high contrast.
